title: Blank the Spire updates: The Un-Claude-ing and Chinese support
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
What's up you pretty prompters? I'm here with another update on Blank the Spire the Slay the Spire 2 mod that lets you create your own playable class for Slay the Spire 2.

I really didn't like the look of the website Claude put together for Blank the Spire. My first attempt to de-slopify it (kicking Claude in the shins and telling it to do better) resulted in even sloppier slop, so I went to my literal drawing board and scribbled out some visual ideas on the page which I then described to Mr. Claude in the world's longest and most excruciatingly detailed voice message.

This time he got it right.

[https://www.blankthespire.com/?look=board](https://www.blankthespire.com/?look=board)

Bold! He really nailed the big text just the way I had scribbled it out. I had him set it up as a little A/B test for me just for sanity's sake, so you might still see the old design if you go to the base URL.

I also noticed a few atqq email addresses signing up, which I know means players from China region finding me somehow, so I went ahead and did a machine translation for Chinese. If there are any native speakers out there who might tell me how bad it is (and how it is bad!) I would be forever grateful and would find some way to say thank you.

Speaking of thank you. THANK YOU to all the gamers who have tried Blank the Spire over the last few weeks. I can't believe how much I've learned from launching. If you are reading this and have an idea, now is the time!!

**TLDR:** Verbose descriptions of web design work for Claude, supporting other languages is ez now maybe.
